justifications.clinical.clinicalOutcomes: No outcome comparison studies for BCS-F credential.
justifications.clinical.efficiency: ASHA BCS-F portfolio plus exam; significant documentation requirements.
justifications.clinical.caseloadApplicability: Applicable to fluency disorder specialty practice; narrow clinical population.
justifications.clinical.reimbursement: No BCS-F billing premium; standard SLP fluency billing applies.
justifications.clinical.marketDemand: Limited employer demand; fluency specialty is a narrow SLP subspecialty.
justifications.clinical.patientSatisfaction: Adults who stutter value specialized SLPs.
justifications.business.cashPayViability: Stuttering services are a classic cash-pay SLP niche — families travel and pay out of pocket.
justifications.business.pricingLeverage: Rare specialty with motivated families supports premium rates and intensive program pricing.
justifications.business.marketDifferentiation: Very few SLPs hold BCS-F; one of the strongest differentiators in the SLP world.
justifications.business.ownerLeverage: Hard to fully delegate — clients often seek the credentialed specialist personally — limits scaling.
justifications.business.marketDemand: Stuttering families actively search for fluency specialists; SFA directory drives referrals.
justifications.business.efficiency: Demanding mentorship/portfolio process; significant time investment.
justifications.academicClinical.facultyRecognition: ASHA board specialty — strong faculty credential, especially for fluency course coverage.
justifications.academicClinical.scholarship: Holders frequently publish in fluency/stuttering literature.
justifications.academicClinical.teachingValue: Fluency is a required CSD course area and BCS-F holders are ideal instructors.
justifications.academicClinical.evidenceDepth: Solid evidence base (Lidcombe, Camperdown, stuttering modification) though smaller field.
justifications.academicClinical.facultyDemand: Programs struggle to staff fluency courses — BCS-F holders are highly sought.
justifications.academicClinical.efficiency: Significant time/cost burden but high payoff for niche faculty lines.
